corrections.reason: Visual inspection of Column 1 Line 32 shows only 'አ' at the end of the line, while 'ንጀራ፡' begins on Line 33.
The character 'ን' is printed at the start of Line 33 rather than at the end of Line 32.
The 6th-order 'ህ' in 'ይዘህ' (2nd person masculine singular gerundive) was misread as 1st-order 'ሀ'.
In the Ge'ez citation from Exodus 16:14 ('ወእንዘ የኀድግ ሀቦ' - 'and when the dew went up'), the word for dew is 'ሀቦ' with 1st-order 'ሀ', which is clearly visible at the end of Line 21.
